values.description: Firecrawl API through the api container.
llama-swap reached directly, not through Firecrawl. Held here (rather than only in .env) so the Postman cloud runner has it. Leave the trailing /v1 off: the request appends /v1/models itself.

Secret, deliberately blank here. The real value comes from the untracked .prod copy (firecrawl-integration-test.postman_environment.prod.json, which is what is deployed to Postman), or from .env.prod, or from a shell export - in that order of precedence. Gates the Bull Board request under Queue Admin.
Secret, deliberately blank here. The real value comes from the untracked .prod copy, or from .env.prod, or from a shell export. llama-swap answers 401 without it.
OpenCode Zen host root, no /v1 - the request appends /v1/systemone itself. Leave the trailing /v1 off or it becomes /v1/v1/systemone.

Secret, deliberately blank here. The real value comes from the untracked .prod copy, or from .env.prod, or from a shell export. The Jev request skips itself when this is empty, so a runner without it is not a failure.
Model named in the Jev request body; the response is asserted to echo it.

The SearXNG instance itself, reached directly (bypasses Firecrawl). Runs as its own compose project: /opt/playground/searxng. Same host and port as SEARXNG_ENDPOINT in .env, but that one is Firecrawl's provider endpoint and this one is what these requests talk to. Leave no trailing slash: the requests append /config and /search themselves.
